namespace ClmmMath
def myShlw : Shlw := fun n => (BitVec.ofNat 256 (n.toNat * 2 ^ 64), decide (2 ^ 256 ≤ n.toNat * 2 ^ 64))
theorem my_exact : ShlwExact myShlw := by
  intro n hflag
  unfold myShlw at hflag ⊢
  simp only at hflag ⊢
  have hneg : ¬ (2 ^ 256 ≤ n.toNat * 2 ^ 64) := of_decide_eq_false hflag
  have hlt : n.toNat * 2 ^ 64 < 2 ^ 256 := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hneg
  rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]
theorem my_complete : ShlwComplete myShlw := by
  intro n h
  unfold myShlw
  simp only
  exact decide_eq_false (Nat.not_le.mpr h)
end ClmmMath

  rcases hc with ⟨hz, rfl⟩ | ⟨hd, hl, hflag, q, hdiv, hfit, hamt⟩

    rw [hnum] at hup

    exact hup
